about: How people ask for each plugin, in the words they type into the browse page's search box. Written by Claude (AI) in working sessions (first on 2026-09-30, topped up since) from each plugin's name, repository, descriptions, GitHub topics and job categories; not part of the deterministic profile. Keyed by GitHub owner/repo, matched ignoring case. Plugins still without phrases: pnpm -C site phrases:missing. Indexed by site/src/lib/search.ts.
